response.original_title: Add Pet Policy~How Can I Add a Pet to American Travel?
response.overview: To add a pet to an American Air Lines flight 【+1-800-224-9538】𝖆𝖓𝖉【(+1)_(800)_(224)_(9538)】, you must first book your human passenger ticket and then contact American Reservations as soon as possible by calling 【+1-800-224-9538】𝖆𝖓𝖉【(+1)_(800)_(224)_(9538)】 or through the Fly American app chat.  Next Steps and Requirements  Secure Space Early: Contact American promptly with your pet's breed, weight, and carrier dimensions, as cabin capacity is limited.  Fees: Domestic travel generally incurs a $95 fee each way, paid at airport check-in.  In-Cabin Rules: Permitted pets include small dogs, cats, and domestic birds in a carrier fitting under the seat (recommended soft-sided maximum around 18” x 11” x 11”). Pets must meet age minimums 1-800-224-9538 (10 weeks domestically, older for international/EU), and are restricted from certain destinations like Hawaii, the UK, and Australia.
